newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Providian shareholders agree Aegon merger.
newsitem.headline: Providian shareholders agree Aegon merger.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV said on Monday that Providian shareholders had agreed the merger with Aegon USA.
"This vote was one of the most important steps in securing the necessary approvals before the closing of the transaction with Aegon," said Providian chairman Irving W. Bailey.
"We still expect the spin-off of Providian Financial Corp and the merger with Aegon to be completed in the near future," he added.
In March Aegon said it expected its acquisition of the insurance activities of Providian Corp to be completed in June or July.
The deal, based partly on a tax-free share swap, was also awaiting the outcome of an assessment by U.S. tax authorities.
The transaction represents part of Providian's reorganisation plans in which it will spin off its banking arm Providian Bancorp to its shareholders, while selling its insurance activities to Aegon.
The takeover valued at $3.5 billion is the largest ever by a Dutch company.
